title: Average Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for average energy per particle must be derived.

title: Low Temperature Limit
description: Important Criteria: The behavior of average energy as T approaches 0 must be correctly computed.

title: High Temperature Limit
description: Important Criteria: The behavior of average energy as T approaches infinity must be correctly computed.

title: Specific Heat Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The correct expression for specific heat must be derived.

title: Specific Heat Low Limit
description: Important Criteria: The specific heat as T approaches 0 must be correctly computed.

title: Specific Heat High Limit
description: Important Criteria: The specific heat as T approaches infinity must be correctly computed.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common sign mistakes in the expressions for energy or specific heat must be avoided.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Units must be consistent throughout the derivations and final answers.
